name: testate-pm2-smoke
description: pm2 for scripts/binary/smoke-service.sh, installed with npm ci so every package is pinned by its lockfile hash. The overrides drop three vulnerable transitive packages (Scorecard): js-yaml to its fixed 4.3.2 (GHSA-2883-xcg3-v3hh); chokidar to 4, which no longer depends on braces (GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm, no fixed release), and pm2 uses chokidar only for --watch, which the smoke test does not; and basic-ftp to 6.2.2 (GHSA-c475-qrg2-pj4r, fixed only in 6.2.1), under get-uri, whose calls 6.x still has.
